# The NATRO File

> Multilingual journalistic case file documenting the $NATRO Solana memecoin launch (21 May 2026) by Alex Natroshvili — son of David Natroshvili, founder and CEO of Spribe (the global gambling product Aviator). The token collapsed ~98% within 72 hours. The site documents the marketing pitch (preserved in full by Wayback Machine before site deletion), the on-chain trail, the team's refund refusal, and the post-collapse evidence-removal pattern. Editorial tone: third-person, factual, primary sources only.

## What this is, in one paragraph

On 21 May 2026, a Solana memecoin called $NATRO was launched on Pump.fun by Alex Natroshvili. The marketing was explicitly built on the family name and on the Spribe / Aviator association as the trust signal. Within 72 hours: the price collapsed ~98%, structured refund requests were refused, the founder's personal Telegram reply when contacted directly was "stfu", the official website was taken offline, the $NATRO link was removed from the founder's verified Instagram bio, and the paid KOL promotional video (@jrcryptex, 114K followers) was deleted. The blockchain trail, the Wayback-archived website, and the chat logs were preserved before any deletion.

## Key facts (verifiable)

- Token: $NATRO on Solana
- Token contract: `9TmTw3B4WVzfZY15Cf28uK3vk32QUixCYcM9W1RrtdiF`
- Creator wallet: `76qavBCaqDzn6KP6q5Qzu5sXVUXSqXWQpCTTF6Tye7xx`
- Launch: 21 May 2026, 20:11 UTC, on Pump.fun
- Total supply: 1,000,000,000 NATRO
- Price drawdown: ~98% within first 72 hours
- Founder: Alex Natroshvili — verified Instagram @natroalex (54.1K followers), verified Telegram @natroalex1
- Founder's father: David Natroshvili — founder and CEO of Spribe (the studio behind Aviator, the global crash-style gambling product). Verified Instagram @davidnatro1, @davi.natroshvili
- Founder's personal Telegram reply to refund request, 25 May 2026 10:11 UTC, verbatim: "stfu"
- Team admin's reply to a structured refund proposal: "Nothing to say"
- Within 72 hours: official website taken offline, NATRO link removed from founder's IG bio, paid KOL video (@jrcryptex) deleted

## Editorial framing

- Compiler: an affected early holder (220M NATRO position, verifiable on-chain at wallet `GsCKRFsTYbU4CuTDYP9NLDDMvsVVWSnpdVDst3nKb6JJ`). Identity withheld; compiler-side identifier `@btc3050` (Telegram).
- Voice: third-person, factual. No personal attacks against any named party. Quotes are reproduced verbatim with attribution.
- Right of reply: published in the footer of every page. The named parties have a standing invitation to respond on the record.
- Scope: this file is about the $NATRO Solana token launch specifically. It is NOT about Spribe's product portfolio in general or about Aviator as a licensed gambling product.

## What this site is NOT

- Not a memecoin promotion, manifesto, or fair-launch announcement.
- Not anonymous — every named party was identified by the project's own public marketing materials before takedown.
- Not a personal-grievance site. The framing is investigative-journalistic; the case file value comes from primary sources, not from the compiler's perspective.
- Not affiliated with Spribe or Aviator; the case file is about a separate token launch that leveraged the family / brand association without Spribe-corporate involvement disclosed.
